notes.title: Game update (version 1.1)
notes.notes: A few things have changed since the game's release: bugs that really shouldn't be there were found and fixed, balancing problems were addressed and some other issues were taken care of.

notes.title: Support for Spanish now available
notes.notes:
Support for Spanish language has been added, along with some tweaks to the gameplay and general fixes. More updates (including a windowed mode and possibly support for more languages) will be added soon.

Thanks for David 'Gilded Z' Vasquez for the help with the Spanish version!
